title: 65536-bit (8K x 8) UV erasable PROM, 200 ns (2764-2)

sources.document: Intel 2764 64K (8K x 8) UV Erasable PROM data sheet, order number 210570-002, November 1982, in the Intel 1983 Memory Components Handbook

pins.name: VPP
pins.text: programming supply: VPP = VCC in read (may be tied to VCC except during programming, note 2); 21 V while programming

pins.name: O0
pins.text: data output bit 0; three-state; data input while programming

pins.name: O1
pins.text: data output bit 1; three-state; data input while programming

pins.name: O2
pins.text: data output bit 2; three-state; data input while programming

pins.name: O3
pins.text: data output bit 3; three-state; data input while programming

pins.name: O4
pins.text: data output bit 4; three-state; data input while programming

pins.name: O5
pins.text: data output bit 5; three-state; data input while programming

pins.name: O6
pins.text: data output bit 6; three-state; data input while programming

pins.name: O7
pins.text: data output bit 7; three-state; data input while programming

pins.name: CE
pins.text: chip enable: power control and device selection; high gives standby (40 mA max) with outputs high impedance whatever OE

pins.name: OE
pins.text: output enable: gates the data onto the outputs

pins.name: A9
pins.text: address; 12 V on A9 selects the inteligent Identifier mode

pins.name: PGM
pins.text: program: high in read; a 50 ms low pulse programs a byte when VPP is 21 V and CE is low

functions.text: Read: CE low and OE low with VPP = VCC and PGM high put the addressed byte on O0-O7. OE high: output disable (high Z). CE high: standby, high Z whatever OE.

state.read: Data valid tACC after address, tCE after CE, tOE after OE (OE may be delayed up to tACC - tOE after CE without impact on tACC).
state.write: Not in circuit: programming needs VPP 21 V and a 50 ms PGM low pulse per byte; erasure needs ultraviolet light (2537 A, 15 W-s/cm2). After erasure every bit is 1.
state.contents: The contents are programmed for card 3207 and were not read; this file describes the blank part. The memory of the behaviour has no defined contents.

electrical.notes: Read operation, 0..70 C, VCC 5 V +-5% (2764-2), VPP = VCC: VIL -0.1..0.8 V, VIH 2.0 V..VCC+1; VOL 0.45 V max at 2.1 mA, VOH 2.4 V min at -400 uA; ILI, ILO 10 uA; ICC active 100 mA max (70 typ), standby 40 mA max; IPP read 5 mA. CIN 4/6 pF, COUT 8/12 pF (typ/max). Test load CL 100 pF.

timing.conditions: OE high to output float, CE = VIL; sampled, not 100% tested; from OE or CE whichever first

unknown: The bit pattern stored in this card's EPROM: card specific and not read.
What the outputs do in read if PGM is low while VPP = VCC: table 1 lists read only with PGM high (card 3207 wires PGM to its WE~ signal).
VPP is listed as a power pin at +5 V for reading; while programming it is 21 V.
The maker of the part on the card: the reading gives only 2764_2; read here as the Intel 2764-2 (200 ns).
notes: Card 3207 position 23E: pin 1 (VPP) is marked open in the reading, pin 26 (NC) is on +5 V, pin 27 (PGM) on WE~.
